focus_areas: Head morphology vs. perspective distortion (Coffin-shape verification)
Scale texture definition and boundary sharpness
Spatial grounding of snake on branch (Depth/Boundary)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Critically evaluate the head shape: Is the 'bluntness' a result of the extreme frontal angle (foreshortening) or a failure to generate the correct 'coffin' profile? Use the geometric depth map to confirm if the snout is actually protruding correctly in 3D space. Verify if the scale texture on the snout is distinct or melted into the skin.
image_description: A close-up, frontal view of a green snake (green mamba) coiled on a textured piece of light brown wood or bark. The snake's head is facing the camera directly, appearing somewhat blunt due to the perspective. The scales are glossy and reflective, showing a vivid green coloration.
